reviewed: Operation custody is registered before the first post-await freshness check; late response/lease values are disposed through once-latched handles.
Each operation has fresh per-invocation WeakSets; normal release is latched before invocation and acknowledged before page success under original deadline and lease expiry.
Parent abort, revocation, clock regression, wall timeout and post-await checks permanently hold the invocation; the final wrapper never restores late success.
Separate cleanup-only controls are at most1000ms and have no authority to Fetch, retry release or forward data. Rejected/stalled cleanup is not treated as acknowledged.
Rejected/late Response bodies and active readers use independent once-only cancellation; fully consumed readers release their lock.
Strict duplicate-free parser rejects malformed UTF16 and private projected fields; native environment denials and synthetic fetch are separated.
limitations: The reviewer authored the separate new HTTPS laboratory, not the reviewed core. This does not independently qualify that laboratory.
No Docker, PostgreSQL, provider network, WorkOS account/key or merchant action was used in this review.
Focused synthetic checks are not native DNS/TLS or hosted-secret qualification.
